phoenix.//: Not in the launcher: the app carries the drive accounts (Nextcloud, ownCloud, WebDAV, S3 storage, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, Box: their templates in public/accounts, the sign-in page accounts/wizard.html, the service). A connector package of Phoenix's own that is installed from the catalog's Connections, not pre-installed (docs/SYNERGY-CONNECTORS.md 7). The drives show as places in Files and the pickers.
